howto.name: Upload 2+ images
howto.text: JPG, PNG, WebP — at least 2 files.

howto.name: Choose direction
howto.text: Vertical: top-to-bottom (good for screenshots in sequence). Horizontal: side-by-side (good for before/after).

howto.name: Download the merged image
howto.text: Each input is scaled to a common dimension and concatenated.

faq.a: No — they're scaled to a common dimension (width for vertical, height for horizontal). Smaller images upscale; larger images downscale.

faq.q: What if my images have different aspect ratios?
faq.a: They get letterboxed (transparent padding) to fit. Use Resize Crop Image first to force a common aspect ratio.
Merge concatenates in a single row or column. Collage arranges in a grid with configurable columns.
